caster.doc: Ball caster at the nose: a printed socket holding a loose steel ball.

chassis.doc: Chassis plate: the one part everything else bolts to.

motor_bracket.doc: L-bracket clamping a TT gearmotor to the underside of the chassis.

wheel.doc: Drive wheel pressed onto the TT motor's D-shaft.

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: no AXES declared, so nothing moves
rows.source: a static assembly is fully judged by the fit rule; declare AXES in assembly.py for a machine

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 104.5 × 136.0 mm across 3 bodies at z = -49.50 (caster_ball, wheel_left, wheel_right)
rows.limit: at least 5 mm in both axes
rows.source: union of the contact patches at the lowest plane; a span near zero in either axis is a line or point contact and will tip. Does not test the centre of mass.

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 3 bodies on the plane, 7 above it, none below
rows.source: the lowest plane is taken as the ground, so nothing can be below it by construction; this row records the split
